package task

import (
	"context"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

type courseStructureLessonStub struct{ items []domain.Lesson }

func (stub courseStructureLessonStub) ListByCourse(context.Context, string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	return append([]domain.Lesson(nil), stub.items...), nil
}

type courseStructureTaskStub struct{ items map[string][]domain.Task }

func (stub courseStructureTaskStub) ListByLesson(_ context.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.Task, error) {
	return append([]domain.Task(nil), stub.items[lessonID]...), nil
}

func TestGetInternalCourseStructureReturnsStableCurriculumRevisionAndTargets(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	lessons := []domain.Lesson{
		{ID: "lesson-1", SectionID: "section", Title: "First", Order: 1, Status: domain.LessonStatusActive, UpdatedAt: now},
		{ID: "lesson-2", SectionID: "section", Title: "Second", Order: 2, Status: domain.LessonStatusActive, UpdatedAt: now},
	}
	tasks := map[string][]domain.Task{
		"lesson-1": {{
			ID: "task-1", LessonID: "lesson-1", Title: "Task", Order: 1,
			Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeAuto, UpdatedAt: now,
			LearningTargets: []domain.TaskLearningTarget{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces", Version: "v1"}},
		}},
	}
	useCase := GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: courseStructureLessonStub{items: lessons}, Tasks: courseStructureTaskStub{items: tasks}}
	first, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "course-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get internal course structure: %v", err)
	}
	second, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "course-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get internal course structure again: %v", err)
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(first.CurriculumRevision, "sha256:") || first.CurriculumRevision != second.CurriculumRevision {
		t.Fatalf("curriculum revision is not stable: %q %q", first.CurriculumRevision, second.CurriculumRevision)
	}
	if first.Lessons[0].ID != "lesson-1" || len(first.Lessons[0].Tasks) != 1 || len(first.Lessons[0].Tasks[0].LearningTargets) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("ordered curriculum projection lost target metadata: %+v", first)
	}
	if first.Lessons[0].Tasks[0].LearningTargets[0].Key != "go.interfaces" || first.Lessons[0].UpdatedAt == "" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected curriculum projection: %+v", first.Lessons[0])
	}
}

func TestGetInternalCourseStructurePreservesRepositoryHierarchyOrder(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 8, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	// Lesson.Order is local to a section. The repository already returns this
	// list in course/module/section/lesson order; local zero orders must not be
	// globally resorted by the internal projection.
	lessons := []domain.Lesson{
		{ID: "first-section-first", SectionID: "section-1", Order: 0, Status: domain.LessonStatusActive, UpdatedAt: now},
		{ID: "first-section-second", SectionID: "section-1", Order: 1, Status: domain.LessonStatusActive, UpdatedAt: now},
		{ID: "second-section-first", SectionID: "section-2", Order: 0, Status: domain.LessonStatusActive, UpdatedAt: now},
	}
	useCase := GetInternalCourseStructure{
		Lessons: courseStructureLessonStub{items: lessons},
		Tasks:   courseStructureTaskStub{items: map[string][]domain.Task{}},
	}

	result, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "course-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get internal course structure: %v", err)
	}
	got := []string{result.Lessons[0].ID, result.Lessons[1].ID, result.Lessons[2].ID}
	want := []string{"first-section-first", "first-section-second", "second-section-first"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("lesson order = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
}

func TestGetInternalCourseStructureRejectsMissingDependencies(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := (GetInternalCourseStructure{}).Handle(context.Background(), "course-1"); err != domain.ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticOnlyFiltersAndRedactsByConstruction(t *testing.T) {
	response := &InternalCourseStructureResponse{CourseID: "course-1", Lessons: []InternalCourseStructureLesson{{
		ID: "lesson-1", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive, Tasks: []InternalCourseStructureTask{
			{ID: "knowledge", Type: domain.TaskTypeTest, AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeKnowledgeCheck},
			{ID: "diagnostic", Type: domain.TaskTypeOrdering, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, Version: 3, AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
				LearningTargets: []InternalCourseStructureTarget{{Type: "concept", Key: "go.types"}}},
		},
	}}}
	filtered, err := response.DiagnosticOnly()
	if err != nil || len(filtered.Lessons) != 1 || len(filtered.Lessons[0].Tasks) != 1 || filtered.Lessons[0].Tasks[0].ID != "diagnostic" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected diagnostic projection: %#v %v", filtered, err)
	}
	if filtered.Lessons[0].Tasks[0].AssessmentPurpose != domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic || len(filtered.Lessons[0].Tasks[0].LearningTargets) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("diagnostic identity/targets were not preserved: %#v", filtered.Lessons[0].Tasks[0])
	}
	if filtered.Schema != DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogSchema || filtered.Lessons[0].Tasks[0].Version != 3 || filtered.CurriculumRevision == "" {
		t.Fatalf("diagnostic catalog schema/version/revision missing: %#v", filtered)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticOnlyExcludesInactiveAndRejectsMalformed(t *testing.T) {
	base := InternalCourseStructureResponse{CourseID: "course", Lessons: []InternalCourseStructureLesson{
		{ID: "inactive-lesson", Status: domain.LessonStatusNoActive, Tasks: []InternalCourseStructureTask{{ID: "d1", Type: domain.TaskTypeTest, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic, EvaluationMode: "AUTO"}}},
		{ID: "active-lesson", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive, Tasks: []InternalCourseStructureTask{{ID: "inactive-task", Type: domain.TaskTypeTest, Status: domain.TaskStatusNoActive, AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic, EvaluationMode: "AUTO"}, {ID: "bad", Type: domain.TaskTypeFrontendPreview, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic, EvaluationMode: "AUTO"}}},
	}}
	if _, err := base.DiagnosticOnly(); err != domain.ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("malformed diagnostic should fail closed: %v", err)
	}
	base.Lessons[1].Tasks = base.Lessons[1].Tasks[:1]
	filtered, err := base.DiagnosticOnly()
	if err != nil || len(filtered.Lessons) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("inactive diagnostic items should be excluded: %#v %v", filtered, err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticOnlyBoundAndRevisionChangesWithTaskVersionAndTargets(t *testing.T) {
	response := &InternalCourseStructureResponse{CourseID: "course", Lessons: []InternalCourseStructureLesson{{ID: "lesson", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive, Tasks: []InternalCourseStructureTask{{ID: "task", Type: domain.TaskTypeTest, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, Version: 1, AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic, EvaluationMode: "AUTO", LearningTargets: []InternalCourseStructureTarget{{Type: "concept", Key: "go.types"}}}}}}}
	first, err := response.DiagnosticOnly()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	repeat, err := response.DiagnosticOnly()
	if err != nil || first.CurriculumRevision != repeat.CurriculumRevision {
		t.Fatalf("same input must have deterministic revision: %q %q %v", first.CurriculumRevision, repeat.CurriculumRevision, err)
	}
	response.Lessons[0].Tasks[0].Version = 2
	response.Lessons[0].Tasks[0].LearningTargets[0].Key = "go.interfaces"
	second, err := response.DiagnosticOnly()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if first.CurriculumRevision == second.CurriculumRevision {
		t.Fatal("revision did not change after version/target change")
	}
	response.Lessons[0].Tasks = make([]InternalCourseStructureTask, 101)
	for i := range response.Lessons[0].Tasks {
		response.Lessons[0].Tasks[i] = InternalCourseStructureTask{ID: "task", Type: domain.TaskTypeTest, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic, EvaluationMode: "AUTO"}
	}
	if _, err := response.DiagnosticOnly(); err != domain.ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("more than 100 diagnostic tasks should fail: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticOnlyRejectsNonAutoEvaluationModes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, evaluationMode := range []string{"MANUAL", "HYBRID", "INVALID"} {
		t.Run(evaluationMode, func(t *testing.T) {
			response := &InternalCourseStructureResponse{CourseID: "course", Lessons: []InternalCourseStructureLesson{{
				ID: "lesson", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive, Tasks: []InternalCourseStructureTask{{
					ID: "diagnostic", Type: domain.TaskTypeClassification, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive,
					AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic, EvaluationMode: evaluationMode,
				}},
			}}}
			if _, err := response.DiagnosticOnly(); err != domain.ErrValidation {
				t.Fatalf("evaluation mode %q should fail closed, got %v", evaluationMode, err)
			}
		})
	}
}
